name: O:I — Expressions (oi-native-field-studies)
description: A native particle-field instrument for composing scenes and living expressions: one GPGPU particle medium with first-class entities, text layers, composition and automation sequenced against a single simulation clock; journeys authoring (oi.journey v1) with a lossless native-config bridge (schema v4). The original React workbench remains at /legacy.html and the portable single-file artifact is field-studies.html.
